subject: Next steps: VoltBank trial success criteria & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@voltbank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: VoltBank trial success criteria & kickoff plan

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. I wanted to capture the key takeaways and propose a concrete plan so we can lock timelines and owners. Quick recap:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference performance on VoltBank transaction enrichment pipeline and measure per-transaction cost at expected throughput (~120 req/s).
- Primary success criteria (proposed):
  1) End-to-end latency (median) below 220ms for 8k token window on N=90% of requests.
  2) Quality: precision of entity extraction >= 93% on the evaluation prompt set you shared.
  3) Stability: no more than 1% error/retry rate over 48-hour continuous run.
  4) Cost: token cost per 1k tokens under target $X (we'll refine after initial run).

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- Oct 21 — Trial kickoff (intro + environment access). Owner: Marcus Lin (SE) + Mark Ellis (VoltBank).
- Oct 22–28 — Baseline data ingestion + sandbox integration (patch keys, sample payloads). Owner: Mark Ellis / Marcus.
- Oct 29 — First short readout: latency & basic correctness (internal). Owner: Soojin / Marcus.
- Nov 5 — Full stability run (48 hours). Owner: VoltBank / Redwood operations.
- Nov 9 — Final readout and mutual evaluation against success criteria; decision to expand or adjust. Owner: Alex / Soojin.

Immediate asks for your team to unblock the kickoff:
1) Confirm the two VoltBank owners for this trial (CTO contact and Data Eng) so we can set access.
2) Provide a small sample set (500 records) and one representative production payload.
3) Any network/IP allowlist constraints or data residency concerns.

I've attached a lightweight evaluation template to capture metrics during the run and a short checklist for the sandbox setup. I'll have Rachel schedule recurring 30-minute check-ins (weekly) that can be canceled if not needed.

If that plan looks good I can send a calendar invite for Oct 21. Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments referenced: redwood-trial-eval-template.xlsx, voltbank-data-checklist.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@voltbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@voltbank.com>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@voltbank.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: VoltBank trial success criteria & kickoff plan

Thanks Soojin — that is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: the quality threshold looks right, but can we add a secondary metric for false-positive rate (FPR) on entity extraction? Let's target FPR <= 5%.
- Cost target: I don't have an exact $ yet; we'll use the baseline run to set an internal cost threshold.
- Owners: Priya Singh (CTO) will be the exec sponsor; Mark Ellis (Data Eng) will be the hands-on owner and point for infra access.
- Data residency: VoltBank requires EU-only storage for PII — for this trial we'll use pseudonymized data in our internal sandbox but want to confirm Redwood's sandbox can be restricted to eu-west region.

Mark and I are available for the Oct 21 kickoff; Priya will join the first readout if timing allows. Please confirm region constraints and whether you need a signed DPA before we proceed.

Quick note: I pulled the attachments and the eval template looks useful — we'll fill the sample set by EOD Monday (Oct 19).

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Data Platforms
VoltBank
alex.turner@voltbank.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@voltbank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@voltbank.com>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@voltbank.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: VoltBank trial success criteria & kickoff plan

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex — good additions. Responses inline:

- FPR metric: added. Updated success criteria: precision >= 93%, FPR <= 5%.
- Region: we can run the sandbox exclusively in eu-west for this engagement. Marcus will provision the instance and confirm the IP ranges for allowlist.
- DPA: standard DPA will be fine for this trial; I'll loop in our Legal if you need a countersigned copy prior to data transfer. For pseudonymized samples it's not strictly required, but happy to follow VoltBank process.

Owners from Redwood:
- Commercial lead: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.com) — contract/ops and calendar coordination.
- SE & infra: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) — sandbox provisioning and test run orchestration.

Calendar & practicals: Rachel will send a 30-minute kickoff invite for Oct 21 (I suggest 10:00–10:30 PT / 19:00–19:30 CET). Marcus will post the allowlist ranges by EOD today and drop sandbox credentials into the shared Drive folder.

Action items assigned here:
- Alex / Mark: upload 500-sample payload + one production example to the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-VoltBank-Trial) by Mon Oct 19.
- Marcus: provision eu-west sandbox and share allowlist + test endpoint by EOD Oct 16.
- Rachel: send invites and create a weekly 30-minute recurring check-in for the trial window.

I'll also attach a short runbook for the 48-hour stability test so Mark's team has steps to start/stop and collect logs. Let me know if you'd like a pre-kickoff call with Marcus only to walk through the payload mapping.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Soojin
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@voltbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@voltbank.com>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@voltbank.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: VoltBank trial success criteria & kickoff plan

Perfect — Oct 21 works for us at the suggested time. Mark will upload the sample payloads by Monday and Priya will try to join the readout. We don't need a countersigned DPA for pseudonymized data; will flag if anything changes.

See you on the 21st.

—Alex
